title: Completed base-change map
statement:
Let $\square=(f,f',g,g',\alpha)$ be a cartesian square of schemes
[def-weil-pbc-cartesian-square], with $f:X\to Y$ proper,
$g:Y'\to Y$, $g':X'\to X$, and $f':X'\to Y'$.
Let $(A,I)$ be the adic coefficient datum
[def-weil-pbc-adic-coefficient-datum], with $P_n=A/I^n$ for $n\geq1$,
and use its sheaves $A_T$ and $(P_n)_T$ and its strict reduction towers.
Let $K\in D(X_{\Proet},A)$ be derived $I$-complete, meaning that its
canonical completion map $K\to\Rlim K_\bullet$ is an isomorphism, where
$K_n=K\otimes^L_{A_X}(P_n)_X$ and $\Rlim$ is
[def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-limit]. For each $n$, retain a specified
etale-origin witness $(L_n,\alpha_n)$
[def-weil-pbc-etale-origin-witness], with
$L_n\in D^+(X_{\Et},P_n)$ and $\alpha_n:\nu_X^*L_n\xrightarrow{\sim}K_n$.

Write $Lg_n^*$ and $Lg_n'^*$ for derived pullback with finite
coefficient sheaves $(P_n)_T$, as in
[def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Use the corners $A_n,B_n,D_n$ of [def-weil-pbc-four-corners] and the
arrows of [def-weil-pbc-four-arrows]:
$$
\begin{aligned}
 A_n&=Lg_n^*((Rf_*K)\otimes_A^LP_n),&
 B_n&=Lg_n^*Rf_*K_n,&
 D_n&=Rf'_*Lg_n'^*K_n,\\
 h_n&=Lg_n^*(\pi_{f,K,P_n}):A_n\xrightarrow{\sim}B_n,&
 v'_n&:B_n\longrightarrow D_n.
\end{aligned}
$$
Here $\pi$ is the specified projection-formula map
[def-weil-pbc-projection-formula-map], and $v'_n$ is the finite-level
pro-etale exchange map transported using the displayed witness.
The tower objects and the tower morphisms $h_\bullet,v'_\bullet$ are
those supplied by [def-weil-pbc-completed-four-towers]; all finite-level
objects are restricted to the ambient $A$-coefficient category before
applying the triangulated functor $\Rlim$ of
[prop-weil-pbc-rlim-functoriality].

Write $S=Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K$, where completed pullback is
[def-weil-pbc-completed-pullback]. Fix the canonical identification
$S\xrightarrow{\sim}\Rlim A_\bullet$ coming from that definition
applied to the reduction tower of $Rf_*K$. The completeness of
$Rf_*K$, the compatible projection-formula isomorphisms, and the
canonical direct-image/derived-limit comparison are supplied by
[prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits]. Put
$$
 s:\ S\xrightarrow{\sim}\Rlim A_\bullet
       \xrightarrow{\Rlim(h_\bullet)}\Rlim B_\bullet.
$$
For $M_\bullet=Lg'^*_{\operatorname{Tow}}K_\bullet$, let
$$
 c_{f',M}:Rf'_*\Rlim M_\bullet
       \xrightarrow{\sim}\Rlim(Rf'_*^{\operatorname{Tow}}M_\bullet)
       =\Rlim D_\bullet
$$
be the canonical comparison of [prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits],
using the tower identifications above. Define the completed base-change
map to be exactly the following ordered composite:
$$
\begin{aligned}
 \Ex^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}:\quad
 Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K
 &\xrightarrow{s}\Rlim B_\bullet\\
 &\xrightarrow{\Rlim(v'_\bullet)}\Rlim D_\bullet\\
 &\xrightarrow{c_{f',M}^{-1}}Rf'_*\Rlim M_\bullet
   =Rf'_*Lg'^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K.
\end{aligned}
$$
The specified projection-formula maps, the transported finite-level
exchange maps, and the inverse of the specified comparison are part of
this definition; arbitrary isomorphisms between the displayed objects
are not substituted for them.

This is the blueprint's explicit construction of the map whose
construction is omitted in Stacks Tag 09C9
(proetale.tex, theorem-proper-base-change). Stacks Tag 099N
(proetale.tex, lemma-pushforward-Noetherian-case, clauses (1), (4), (5))
provides the constant-Noetherian-coefficient completion formulas;
Tag 0944 (sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-projection-formula) supplies the
perfect projection formula, and direct-image/derived-limit commutation is supplied by
[prop-weil-pbc-direct-image-limits] (its ringed-topos source is
sites-cohomology.tex, lemma-Rf-commutes-with-Rlim). The strict tower refinement and the
chosen witness transports here are those of the cited DAG nodes,
not additional assertions attributed to Tag 099N.

blueprint_sketch.statement:
Let $K$ be derived complete and let every $K_n$ have a displayed witness
$\epsilon_X^{-1}L_n\simeq K_n$ with
$L_n\in D_c^+(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda/I^n)$. Define

$$
\operatorname{Ex}^{\mathrm{comp}}_{\square,K}:
Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K\longrightarrow
Rf'_*L(g')^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K
$$

to be the ordered composite

$$
\begin{aligned}
Lg^*_{\mathrm{comp}}Rf_*K
&\xrightarrow{\sim}R\varprojlim_n Lg^*Rf_*K_n\\
&\xrightarrow{R\varprojlim_n\operatorname{Ex}_{\square,K_n}}
R\varprojlim_nRf'_*L(g')^*K_n\\
&\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_*R\varprojlim_nL(g')^*K_n
=Rf'_*L(g')^*_{\mathrm{comp}}K.
\end{aligned}
$$

In the notation above, the first two arrows are $H$ followed by $V'$.
The first isomorphism uses reconstruction and the perfect projection formula;
the second displayed isomorphism is the inverse of direct-image/limit
commutation. This definition fills the map-construction omission in Tag
`09C9`.
